title: An out-of-bounds write in the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware could allow a malicious hypervisor to…
description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware. This flaw could allow a malicious hypervisor to corrupt global firmware variables, potentially compromising firmware integrity. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating and no known exploits in the wild. No affected versions or patches are specified in the available data.
